issues.legal_issue: An assessment of income that was not earned or assessable in the assessed person’s hands may be erroneous and prejudicial to the revenue where it is made to benefit another person who would otherwise be liable for a larger amount, giving the Commissioner authority to cancel it and initiate proceedings against the person liable for the income.
material_facts: The taxpayer filed a voluntary return reporting income from capital, ornament sales, business and investments, which the assessing officer accepted without inquiry or supporting evidence.
The Commissioner’s inquiries indicated that the taxpayer neither resided nor carried on business at the address stated in the return.

The Commissioner found circumstances casting doubt on the claimed sources of income and indicating a connection with the taxpayer’s husband’s business, including investments in a firm in which he was a partner.
The Commissioner cancelled the assessment and directed a fresh assessment after further inquiries; the challenge to the Commissioner’s authority was rejected.
issues.conclusion: The Commissioner had jurisdiction to cancel the assessment as erroneous and prejudicial to the interests of the revenue and could initiate assessment proceedings against another person whom the income-tax authorities considered liable for the income.
issues.legal_principle: Section 33B of the Income-tax Act, 1922 empowers the Commissioner to examine proceedings and make orders justified by the circumstances where an assessment is erroneous insofar as it is prejudicial to the revenue. An assessment may meet that description even if the income was not earned or assessable in the assessed person’s hands, where it was assessed there to assist someone else who would otherwise have been assessed for a larger amount. Rampyari Devi Saraogi v. Commissioner of Income-tax was followed. Commissioner of Income-tax v. Rao Thakur Narayan Singh was explained as concerning an attempt to reopen an assessment contrary to a final Tribunal order, and did not assist the taxpayer here.

predicates.commissioner_review_of_tax_assessment: A Commissioner reviewed an assessment in a proceeding to determine whether it should be set aside or otherwise revised.
predicates.income_not_earned_or_assessable_in_asses: The income reported in the assessment was not earned by, or assessable in the hands of, the person assessed.
predicates.assessment_intended_to_benefit_another_t: The income was assessed in that person’s hands to assist another person who would otherwise face assessment on a larger amount.

issues.definition: When a Commissioner reviews an assessment and the income was not earned or assessable in the assessed person’s hands but was placed there to benefit another taxpayer, the Commissioner may cancel the assessment and initiate proceedings against the person liable for the income.
